title: Sitting MLAs average declared assets by state
definition: Mean declared movable and immovable assets per sitting Member of Legislative Assembly across 4,092 analysed MLAs in 28 states and 3 Union Territories, highlighting India's national average alongside the highest- and lowest-average states.

sources.publisher: Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR) and National Election Watch
sources.title: Analysis of Sitting MLAs from 28 State Assemblies and 3 Union Territories (March 2025)

points.evidence: The average of assets per MLA from state assemblies is Rs 17.92 crore (4,092 sitting MLAs holding Rs 73,348 crore total).
The state with the highest average assets per MLA is Andhra Pradesh (174 MLAs) with average assets of Rs 65.07 crore.
Followed by Karnataka (223 MLAs, Rs 14,179 crore total) with average assets of Rs 63.58 crore.
Followed by Maharashtra (286 MLAs, Rs 12,424 crore total) with average assets of Rs 43.44 crore.
Kerala (134 MLAs) with average assets of Rs 3.13 crore.
West Bengal (293 MLAs) with average assets of Rs 2.8 crore (printed as Rs 2.80 crore).
Tripura is the state with the lowest average assets of MLAs at Rs 1.51 crore (60 MLAs, Rs 90 crore total).
